budget_items.topic: Eagle Scout loafing shed cost estimate
budget_items.what_was_said: A price sheet from a lumber supplier put the build cost at no more than a stated ceiling, with some materials donated (scrap corrugated metal, rubber) reducing the actual cost. A board member urged the scout to attempt some fundraising rather than rely solely on the DPW budget.

budget_items.topic: School committee warrant article for additional FY27 state aid
budget_items.what_was_said: The school committee asked the select board to place an article on a November 2026 special town meeting warrant to appropriate additional state aid to the FY27 school operating budget.

budget_items.topic: July 8 spending plan for additional state aid (initial version)
budget_items.what_was_said: The superintendent's initial proposal included a primary school reading specialist, a Turkey Hill reading specialist, restoring the high school principal to full-time, and Ignite tutoring license seats; the total exceeded the unappropriated state aid available at the time.

budget_items.topic: General government share of the unappropriated state aid
budget_items.what_was_said: Of the total unappropriated state aid, a portion was general-government aid (UGGA and exemption increases) rather than education aid.
The school committee's revised plan added an increase to the high school music teacher's FTE, offset by reducing the number of Ignite tutoring license seats requested.

budget_items.topic: Select board member's objection to reduced state-aid request
budget_items.what_was_said: A board member said the amount requested for schools had been scaled back from a larger restoration figure to a smaller ask and argued more of the new state revenue should go to classrooms.

budget_items.topic: Context on the state budget the aid comes from
budget_items.what_was_said: A board member noted the additional local aid comes out of a much larger state budget that grew modestly, and does not reflect any structural increase in Chapter 70 investment in Lunenburg.

budget_items.topic: Net education aid figure pending FinCom review
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the true net increase in education aid, after assessments are subtracted, is less than the larger figure cited and will be reviewed at a Finance Committee hearing required for any warrant article involving money.

decisions.decision: One or two select board members (not all three, to avoid posting a full meeting) will meet on-site with the historical society, DPW director, and facilities director to pin down the exact memorial location, then report back.

The chair will meet with town counsel to clarify special-town-meeting procedure for the citizens' petition, and the board will post a meeting for Monday July 27 to set the date of the special town meeting.
The chair will ask the finance committee chair to collect his members' availability so a shared calendar of off-schedule summer meetings can be built.
Select board FY27 goals document will be edited by members individually in the shared drive, with a final draft circulated and a vote expected the following week rather than tonight.

minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Select Board approved an Eagle Scout loafing shed project at the DPW, appointed Richard Howard to the Trust Fund Commission, ratified two town manager appointments, and granted the historical society permission to place a war memorial on the lower common. Most of the meeting was devoted to the school committee's request for a warrant article appropriating roughly $350,000 in additional state aid to the FY27 school budget, including a walkthrough of the state and town budget timelines, a recap of contentious school committee meetings, and next steps now that a citizens' petition has forced an earlier special town meeting; no vote on the state-aid article itself was taken by the select board.
minutes.headline: A citizens' petition forced an earlier special town meeting to consider added state aid for the school budget.
